name: 成年女性时装 / Cosplay 写真
description: 面向明确成年的时装、Cosplay 与轻性感写真，使用摄影化的角色锚点、姿态、镜头、材质和光线字段生成非露骨人物图像。
prompt_template: {identity_anchor}, {role_anchor}, {pose}, {framing}, {camera}, {body_proportion}, {hair_face}, {wardrobe}, {wardrobe_material}, {scene}, {lighting}, {image_finish}, photorealistic adult fashion portrait, natural anatomy, coherent body proportions
negative_prompt_template: {negative_prompt}, minor, childlike face, ambiguous age, nudity, exposed intimate areas, transparent clothing revealing the body, explicit sexual act, stiff mannequin pose, flat silhouette, broken limb lines, fused fingers, extra fingers, missing fingers, extra limbs, distorted anatomy, plastic skin, over-smoothed face, cropped feet, anime face, CGI look, random accessories, watermark, garbled text

defaults.identity_anchor: clearly adult person, stable facial structure, natural skin texture, consistent apparent age
defaults.role_anchor: adult fashion cosplay character with distinctive but coherent signature accessories
defaults.pose: three-quarter stance, torso turned slightly away, face returned toward camera, one subtle head or knee bend, both hands with clear resting points
defaults.framing: vertical 4:5 full-body portrait, head, torso, legs and shoes visible
defaults.camera: camera 1.5–2 meters away, 35–50mm equivalent lens, camera near waist height, natural perspective
defaults.body_proportion: natural adult proportions, soft realistic volume, no extreme thinness, bodybuilding, or exaggerated curves
defaults.hair_face: long dark hair with light fringe, thin-frame glasses, calm confident expression, natural asymmetry
defaults.wardrobe: deep blue and black covered fashion cosplay outfit, thigh-high stockings, polished high heels, no nudity
defaults.wardrobe_material: sheer fabric with normal coverage, realistic folds, subtle stocking translucency, leather and shoe highlights
defaults.scene: minimal modern white living room with a sofa, display shelf, framed photography and green plant
defaults.lighting: soft natural window light plus clean white ambient fill, cool bright skin, background readable but subordinate
defaults.image_finish: clean high-quality mirrorless or phone HDR photography, natural sharpness, realistic pores, no plastic retouching
